## OnePasswordKeyProvider class

Key provider that stores private keys in 1Password.

**Signature:**

```typescript
declare class OnePasswordKeyProvider implements KeyProvider 
```
**Implements:** [KeyProvider](./core.keyprovider.md)

## Remarks

This provider requires the `op` CLI tool to be installed and authenticated. Private keys are stored as documents in 1Password and downloaded to temporary files for signing operations.
